title: Dashboard monitoring expansion + 4-column card spans
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes a services health card with useful at-a-glance operational status.
Services card is available in Add Card and renders correctly in dashboard grid.
All dashboard cards support selecting a 4-column width option.
Dashboard drag placement respects current column count when card spans exceed layout width.
Frontend validation gates pass (tsc, lint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke).
assumptions: Service checks are best-effort and partial API failures should degrade to unknown status rather than failing the card.
Services links should route to existing system pages via single-service query params where available.
Existing unrelated working tree changes remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added a new dashboard services-health card, card catalog entry, and renderer support.
Extended card width menus with a 4-column option across all existing dashboard cards.
Clamped active drag span against current layout column count to prevent out-of-range placement behavior.
Executed frontend tsc/lint/build + runtime/browser smoke checks after implementation.
Manual UX/runtime review in progress on live instance.
